messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] broken URL
parts:
Hi,

that URL does indeed exists, but it did have a fraud message "Please
click the link below once again to confirm you are not a bot and
proceed to the requested site. <link>Moex 1 0 St</link>". The link
goes to a fake/unsafe(?) web page.

We had an attack by a spam bot on March 10, 2008 that registered as a
group member and then add spam basically to all our pages. I went
through all of them an reverted back to a valid version, but it seems
like I missed this one.

Thanks for letting me know

Cheers

Henrik
